releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.9.6 — PowerNap Lock & NVIDIA Notification Fix:
- PowerNap v5 Non-Intrusive Idle Quiescer: Fixed NVIDIA driver reset notifications upon workstation lock by replacing invasive GPU clock clamping and display mode resets with native CPU EPP 200 power-saving and silent fan curves.
- Zero driver alerts, zero screen flicker, and instant silent recovery upon user unlock.
- OmniStabilizer v5 System Engine & AeroCore v5 Predictive Fan PID.
